milestones.title: M0 Baseline and contracts
milestones.description: Immutable 8.1.0 evidence, reconciled command ownership and agreed architecture. Family contract research precedes each implementation; no guessed wire routes.

milestones.title: M1 SDK foundations
milestones.description: Portable Go client, authentication, backend adapters and cross-platform offline checks pass.

milestones.title: M2 Representative proof
milestones.description: Team/channel/membership, policy lifecycle/assignment and voice read workflows have contract proof plus available lab evidence.

milestones.title: M3 Complete management surface
milestones.description: Every in-scope resource and builder is implemented with tests, permissions, examples and coverage links.

milestones.title: M4 Upgrade detection
milestones.description: Versioned and observed differences are classified and mapped to SDK impact; scheduled workflows maintain reviewable candidate draft PRs.

milestones.title: M5 Release qualification
milestones.description: Full implementation and contract coverage, cross-platform gates, available lab regression and honest qualification documentation permit the first supported release.
